scope: Phase 1 bring-over: modified transport/root/health surfaces, excluding response_guards.py; five explicit removed-path selection overrides

evidence.method: Read CONTRIBUTING.md, inspect pinned-baseline git diffs and current source, inspect all four existing test_desktop_strip_*.py files. No tests, native input, service operations, commits or source edits performed for this audit.
evidence.test_status: Named paths below are existing evidence targets, not executed or passing-test claims. Some strip equivalence assertions use exact-copy commit f6170072 rather than the pinned baseline; they do not alone prove upstream equivalence.
evidence.phase1: Neutral helpers, private profile paths, internal state/projection logic and fail-closed gates are implemented. Importability and internal persistence are not authenticated admission, durable event/artifact delivery or a functioning Desktop adapter.
evidence.phase2: Real OS-peer/broker provenance, revision-bound conversation/turn ownership, secure admission sessions, task-owned durable event/artifact sinks and delivery-time authorization/revocation remain blocked. Retained internal effect-capable algorithms are not approved entrypoints; direct construction or caller-supplied identity is not an admission proof.
evidence.coverage_limits: Existing strip tests establish specific gates, transport absence, algorithm pins and selected helper behavior. They do not prove every registrar, ingress, shutdown path, confirmation flow or packaged update contract end-to-end. Authentication and durable-sink integration require separate Phase 2 tests and review.
